He is the featured guest on CARE's own podcast 'Modern Approaches to Spine & Neuro Care with Dr Randhir Kumar' and is profiled in the CARE Banjara Times newsletter, Issue 06, July 2025 (https://www.carehospitals.com/news-letters/care_banjara_times_issue_06_compressed.pdf) - both are CARE-run channels whose producers are a legitimate professional route to him.
verified_role: Clinical Director and Senior Consultant - Neurosurgeon, Neurointerventionist and Endoscopic Spine Surgeon, CARE Hospitals, Banjara Hills; leads the neurosurgery and spine surgery programme there

hni_signals: TOP-TIER LEADERSHIP: 'Clinical Director & Senior Consultant' at CARE Hospitals Banjara Hills, publicly stated to LEAD the neurosurgery and spine surgery programme - a departmental headship. His arrival was treated as a strategic hire and announced through a national press release, 'A Landmark in Neurosciences: Dr. Randhir Kumar Joins CARE Hospitals to Redefine Standards in Neurosurgery at Banjara Hills', syndicated by The Tribune (tribuneindia.com), Sangri Today and Brunei News - an unusually high-profile recruitment. MULTIPLE INTERNATIONAL FELLOWSHIPS: global fellowships in Endoscopic Spine Surgery from the USA and Germany, plus Fellowship in Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery, Fellowship in Endovascular Surgery and Fellowship in Micro Neurosurgery. Publicly described as 'one of the very few neurosurgeons in the country proficient in both open vascular neurosurgery and endovascular (neurointerventional) procedures' - a scarce dual-credential. Award: Baidya Ratna award. Training pedigree: MBBS Patna Medical College (1997), MS Gandhi Medical College Bhopal, MCh Neurosurgery from G B Pant Hospital / Maulana Azad Medical College, New Delhi (2005). Thought-leadership: named guest on CARE Hospitals' own podcast and featured in the CARE Banjara Times newsletter. Premium specialty mix: brain tumour surgery, skull-base and cranial surgery, aneurysms and AVMs, scoliosis correction, craniosynostosis and epilepsy surgery. Career across several major Hyderabad private hospitals (CARE Banjara Hills now; previously Century Hospital Banjara Hills, with directory records also citing Virinchi Hospitals Banjara Hills and Continental Hospitals Gachibowli).
